title: Come and See
pages: Come here! We have a hen.
The hen is on a big log.
What is in the shed? Come and see!
Some eggs are here. They are red!
We have some eggs. What fun!
We are all here. Come and see them!

title: Hen and the Egg
pages: My hen is red. She is here!
The hen has one egg.
What is it? It is a chick!
The chick is with the hen.
They run and they nap.
What fun they have!

title: Come to the Hut
pages: Come to my hut! We have fun.
There is a big pot. What is in it?
Some ham! We have ham. Yum!
They are all here. Come and see.
We sit and we chat.
What fun we have!

title: Pig in the Mud
pages: The sun is hot, hot, hot! A pig is in the sun.
The pig can see the mud. Mud, mud, mud!
The pig can dig. Dig in the mud!
The pig can hop. Hop in the mud!
Mud on the pig! Fun, fun, fun!
The pig can nap. Such a big mud pig!

title: The Hen and Eggs
pages: A hen sat in the shed. She had ten eggs.
The hen sat on the eggs. Sit, hen, sit!
The hen sat and sat and sat.
Then tap, tap, tap! Pop, pop, pop!
A chick! The chick is wet.
The hen and the chick hug. Yes!

title: The Red Ship
pages: See the big red ship.
It can go in the sun.
The ship can dip and rock.
Dip and rock! It is so fun.
See the fish! The fish see us.
The red ship can nap. It was fun!

title: Rex and the Fish
pages: Rex is big. Rex is wet.
Rex can see a fish!
The fish can dip. Rex can hop.
Dip, fish! Hop, Rex!
Dip and hop. So much fun!
Rex can hug the fish. Yes!

title: Fox and Hen
pages: A fox sat in the sun. The fox had no fun.
The fox can see a hen. A hen!
The hen ran and ran. Run, hen, run!
Hush, hen! said the fox. I do not chomp hens.
The fox has a bun. It is for us!
The hen sat. We had fun. Big hug!

title: The Cat Nap
pages: The cat can nap. But not yet!
Nap on the mat? Not this cat.
Nap on a lap? Not this cat.
Nap in the sun? Yes, this cat!
The sun is hot. The cat sat.
Nap, cat, nap. Fun in the sun!

title: Bug in a Rug
pages: A bug is in the rug.
A big pup can dig.
Dig and dig and dig!
Pop! I see you!
The pup and bug hug.
Yes! Fun for us!

title: Jam On Ham
pages: I see jam. I see red jam!
Jam on ham. Yum yum!
Jam on a bun. Jam on an egg.
Jam on a pot. Jam on a pan.
Jam on you and me! So wet!
So much fun. Yum yum!

title: The Big Fish
pages: A big fish sat in a dish.
The big fish had a wish.
A wish for fun in the sun.
Then a kid ran to the fish.
The kid and fish had fun. Wet fun in the sun!
The big fish got the wish. Yes!

title: Fox and Sock
pages: Fox has a red sock. It is a fun sock.
The sock is on Fox. Hop, Fox, hop!
Fox can hop on a rock. Hop, Fox, hop!
The red sock got wet. Wet, wet, wet!
Is Fox sad? No, not Fox!
Hop, Fox, hop! Fox has so much fun.

title: The Best Nest
pages: A hen has a nest.
The nest is on a big log.
The hen sat on the nest.
The nest is the best nest!
A red egg is in the nest. Yes!

title: The Red Flag
pages: The pup has a red flag.
The flag is not flat.
The pup is so glad.
The pup ran fast. The flag can flip!
The pup and the flag nap in the sun.

title: Frog and Crab
pages: A frog sat on a log.
The frog has a drum.
A crab ran to the frog.
The crab can grab the drum.
The frog has a big grin!

title: The Twin Fish
pages: The twin fish can swim.
The twin fish swim fast.
The fish can spin and skip.
A fish has a red spot.
The twin fish swim to a big rock.

title: The Big Tent
pages: The big tent is on the sand.
A frog can jump in the pond.
The lamp is red. It is not hot.
I get a gift! Yes!
The gift is a big drum!

title: The Cake
pages: I can make a cake.
I made a big cake.
A pig came to the cake.
The pig ate the cake!
The pig is so glad.

title: The Green Boat
pages: I see a green boat.
The boat is in the rain.
A goat is in the boat.
The goat can see the hay.
The goat can stay in the boat.

title: The Big Farm
pages: I see a big red barn.
A car is in the yard.
Corn is in the farm.
A bird is on the barn.
The bird can see a star.

title: The Big Beach
pages: We go to the beach. It is bright!
I can see the sea. It is deep.
We eat a meal on a mat.
We see a seal and a fish.
At night we see a light.
What a fun day at the beach!

title: The King
pages: The king has a big ring.
Bring the ring to the king!
We sing a song.
The king can sing a long song.
The pink drink is in the sink.
What fun! The king can sing!

title: My Bike
pages: I have a bike. It is red.
I ride the bike home.
We made a big cake.
The cake is on the gate.
What a fun time!
Come and see my bike!

title: In the Park
pages: We go to the park.
A dog can run and bark.
It is dark. We see a star.
A bird is in a tree.
The girl has a red card.
What fun in the park!

title: The Rain
pages: It is a wet day.
The rain is here.
We see a boat on the sea.
A fish is in the sea.
At night we see the light.
What a fun day in the rain!

title: The Brown Owl
pages: A brown owl is in a tree.
The owl is up high.
A cow is down in the town.
The boy has a toy.
We found a coin!
What a fun day out!

title: The Loud Clown
pages: A clown is in the town.
The clown has a red toy.
The toy is a brown cow.
The cow can jump up and down!
We found a coin in the mud.
What fun we had!

title: Stop the Bus
pages: The red bus must stop.
Stop, bus! Stop!
A hen is on the bus.
The hen has a nest.
It is the best nest.
The best bus! Yes!

title: The Glad Pup
pages: The pup is glad.
It can clap and clap.
The pup has a flag.
The flag is flat.
The pup can slip on the mud.
The glad pup can nap. Yes!

title: The Frog and the Drum
pages: The frog has a drum.
The frog can grab it.
A crab ran to the drum.
The crab has a big grin.
Drip, drip! It is wet.
The frog and crab grin. Yes!

title: Swim and Spin
pages: The fish can swim.
It can swim fast.
The fish can spin.
It can skip and skip.
The fish has a red spot.
Swim, fish, swim! Yes!

title: The Lake
pages: The lake is big.
I ride my bike to the lake.
A mule came to the lake.
The mule can nap.
We made a big cake.
We ate the cake. Yum!

title: The Barn
pages: The barn is on the farm.
A bird is on the barn.
Corn is in the cart.
It is dark. I see a star.
The girl can run in the yard.
What fun on the farm!
